title: Through the tunnel
done: Into the dark, out the other side, and crunch! Beep, beep.

steps.say: Put a yellow square flat on the table. The road starts here.
One more square, flat on the table, next to the last.
One more square, flat on the table, next to the last.
One more square, flat on the table, next to the last.
Stand two big squares facing each other, two squares apart, and lay a big square across their tops. A tunnel!
Past the tunnel, lay another square flat for the road.
One more square, flat on the table, next to the last.
One more square, flat on the table, next to the last.
One more square, flat on the table, next to the last.
For a crush car at the end of the road, lay a red square flat.
Stand four red squares round it.
A red square on top. Ready to crush!
